x-axis.d: the horizontal axis in a plane coordinate system

x-ray.d: a radiogram made by exposing photographic film to X rays; used in medical diagnosis

x-radiation.d: electromagnetic radiation of short wavelength produced when high-speed electrons strike a solid target

x-linked.d: relating to genes or characteristics or conditions carried on the X chromosome

x-scid.d: SCID in male children resulting from mutation of a gene that codes for a protein on the surface of T cells that allows them to develop a growth factor receptor

x-raying.d: obtaining images by the use of X rays
